plan.summary: PR-3b-2 (cxapi delivery-ack ingress): the existing Backend /api/v1/webhook/event handler now shape-discriminates the WapCRM SubscribedWebhook payload — inbound messages[] path is unchanged; an ack payload (root Status/InstanceMessageID, no messages[]) is mapped (PascalCase ack -> snake_case DeliveryStatusRequest, Status int 1-4 -> sent/delivered/read/failed) and forwarded to Outbound's existing /api/v1/webhook/delivery-status with a minted service JWT (tenant=companyId). Outbound's delivery-status path is hardened into ONE atomic, tenant-scoped, idempotent, partition-correct apply (downgrade guard + transition-gated broadcast counter). Prod-inert until the P0-3 gate opens.

plan.interview_notes: AskUserQuestion (2026-06-08, all 3 = recommended): (1) SERVICE SPLIT = 'Reuse delivery-status' — Backend discriminates+maps+forwards to Outbound's EXISTING /webhook/delivery-status (one correlation path; hardening benefits the legacy bridge too). Forced by microservice isolation: outbound_messages is owned EXCLUSIVELY by Invekto.Outbound (grep: zero refs in Backend); /webhook/event is in Backend. Memory project_cxapi_ack_ingress_design describes the LOGICAL flow ('ack block in /webhook/event'); the PHYSICAL impl is Backend-discriminate -> Outbound-correlate. (2) UNKNOWN WAMID = '202 swallow + log' (public /webhook/event returns 202 to WapCRM even when the ack matches no row; WapCRM retries on non-2xx and most acks legitimately won't match: bridge/non-cxapi sends + all prod rows have NULL ext_id while the gate is closed). (3) INSTANCEID CROSS-CHECK = 'Soft: log on mismatch' (apply anyway; wamid + tenant-scoped UNIQUE already guarantee single-row correctness; instance_id is nullable at send time). FINDING (counter): the existing IncrementBroadcastCounterAsync is funnel-style (+1 only) and works today ONLY because delivery acks never correlate in prod (external_message_id NULL on every row, migration 058). Once acks land it breaks the documented partition invariant (sent+delivered+read+failed+ambiguous+queued=total_recipients). PR-3b-2 therefore makes the counter MOVE BUCKETS (increment new, decrement old) atomically — required for correctness, not scope creep. Pattern mirrors the shipped MarkCxapiOutcomeAsync single-CTE (OutboundRepository.cs:802). FOR UPDATE in the CTE serializes out-of-order/concurrent acks so the bucket-move reads the LIVE prior status (prevents a snapshot-stale double-count). NO DB migration needed: schema (056 states + 058 unique) already supports everything; DeliveryStatusRequest.instance_id is DTO-only (instance_id column already exists). Gate (P0-3) stays CLOSED.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Backend /api/v1/webhook/event shape-discriminates by payload: root-level non-empty messages[] -> existing inbound path (byte-identical behavior, same message_log/photo/instance-filter/Automation-forward + 202); root-level Status or InstanceMessageID with NO messages[] -> ack branch. Malformed/empty body -> 400 IntegrationWebhookInvalidPayload (unchanged). The inbound path's Automation forward output is unchanged (deserialize to IncomingWebhookEvent with Web options, then JsonSerializer.Serialize as today).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The ack branch maps WapCRMCloudAPIAckWebHookModel (PascalCase: InstanceID int, InstanceMessageID, Status int, StatusText, ReasonDetailForNotSent) to DeliveryStatusRequest: status = MapAckStatus(1->sent,2->delivered,3->read,4->failed); external_message_id = InstanceMessageID; failed_reason = ReasonDetailForNotSent (only for Status=4, truncated to 500); instance_id = InstanceID. Unsupported/absent status (0 Pending, 5 Deleted, other) or blank InstanceMessageID -> no-op, logged, 202 (no forward). Forward uses OutboundClient.ProxyPostAsync to /api/v1/webhook/delivery-status with a minted 5-min service JWT (tenant=companyId, role=system, purpose=webhook_proxy) when the inbound was IP-whitelisted. Public endpoint ALWAYS returns 202 to WapCRM (forward failure / 404 / non-2xx is logged INV-BE-131, never propagated).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Outbound /api/v1/webhook/delivery-status reads ctx.Items[TenantContext] and calls a single atomic OutboundRepository.ApplyDeliveryStatusAsync(tenantId, externalMessageId, status, failedReason, ct) instead of the old Find+Update+Increment trio. Returns 400 (missing ext_id / status not in sent|delivered|read|failed), 404 (no matching (tenant_id, external_message_id) row), 200 otherwise (applied OR idempotent no-op). Soft InstanceID cross-check: if DeliveryStatusRequest.instance_id and the matched row's instance_id are both present and differ, log INV-OB-072 (warn) and apply anyway.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ApplyDeliveryStatusAsync is atomic (single CTE, mirrors MarkCxapiOutcomeAsync), tenant-scoped (WHERE tenant_id=@tid AND external_message_id=@eid, backed by uq_outbound_messages_tenant_external_id), with a monotonic downgrade guard (rank sent=1<delivered=2<read=3 forward-only; failed applies only over queued/sending/posting/sent; never regress read->delivered or override a delivered/read with failed) and a partition-correct, transition-gated broadcast counter (on a real transition with broadcast_id: increment the new bucket, GREATEST-decrement the old bucket; queued covers queued/sending/posting). FOR UPDATE serializes concurrent acks so the counter uses the live prior status. A duplicate/out-of-order ack is a no-op (applied=false) and never re-counts. The now-dead tenant-blind FindMessageByExternalIdAsync is removed; UpdateMessageStatusAsync/IncrementBroadcastCounterAsync are untouched (still used by the send path).

verification_questions.question: Does the rewritten Backend /webhook/event preserve the LIVE inbound path byte-for-byte — same message_log inserts, photo media hop, instance filtering, Automation forward (JsonSerializer.Serialize of the deserialized IncomingWebhookEvent), and 202 shape — so no current tenant's inbound message processing regresses?

Is the shape discrimination robust against the InstanceID type trap (string in inbound, int in ack) and against ambiguous/empty payloads, so an inbound message is NEVER misrouted to the ack branch and vice versa, and a malformed body still yields the same 400 as before?

Is ApplyDeliveryStatusAsync correct AND safe under duplicate/out-of-order acks: tenant-scoped single-row lookup, monotonic downgrade guard (no read->delivered regress, no failed over delivered/read), and a partition-correct counter that increments the new bucket + decrements the live old bucket exactly once per real transition (no double-count, no negative), with FOR UPDATE serializing concurrent acks?

Does the cross-service forward keep tenant isolation: tenant is derived from companyId/TenantContext (not the payload), a fresh service JWT carries that tenant to Outbound, and a wamid can only ever resolve to its own tenant's message (uq_outbound_messages_tenant_external_id), so no ack can be mis-attributed across tenants?

Does PR-3b-2 keep the P0-3 gate intact and stay prod-inert (no allowlist change; every ack 404s while external_message_id is NULL on all prod rows, swallowed to 202; no counter movement), and is it correctly a no-migration code-only change over the existing 056/058 schema?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Two intentional soft paths, both BY DESIGN and logged, not silent: (1) an ack with no matching (tenant,wamid) row returns 404 from Outbound which Backend swallows to 202 + logs (Q answer #2) — correct because WapCRM retries on non-2xx and most acks legitimately won't match while the gate is closed (all prod rows have NULL ext_id). (2) an InstanceID cross-check mismatch logs INV-OB-072 (warn) and applies anyway (Q answer #3, SOFT) — correct because wamid + tenant-scoped UNIQUE already guarantee single-row correctness and instance_id is nullable at send time. The Backend->Outbound forward failure (timeout/5xx) is logged INV-BE-131 and the public endpoint still returns 202; WapCRM's at-least-once redelivery re-drives it (idempotent apply makes redelivery safe). No exception escapes to the caller; the LIVE inbound path's existing typed error handling is unchanged.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operators send cxapi broadcasts but the per-recipient state is frozen at 'sent' — they can't tell delivered from read from failed.
aha_moments.suggestion: The ack ingress flips each recipient row through sent->delivered->read (or failed) as WhatsApp reports back, with a downgrade guard so a late ack never regresses the truth.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The operator refreshes a broadcast and watches read counts climb in near real-time instead of a static 'sent'.

aha_moments.user_pain: Duplicate or out-of-order delivery webhooks (WapCRM gives no ordering guarantee and may resend) silently corrupt broadcast counters past 100%.
aha_moments.suggestion: The atomic transition-gated counter moves a message between buckets exactly once; replays are no-ops.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The team trusts the broadcast dashboard because delivered+read+failed+queued always equals the recipient count, even after retries.

aha_moments.user_pain: When a customer says 'I never got it', support has no provider-side reason to show.
aha_moments.suggestion: A NotSent ack stores ReasonDetailForNotSent against the matched row, surfaced on the recipient detail.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support pastes the number and immediately reads 'failed (131026) Message Undeliverable'.

aha_moments.user_pain: Cross-tenant mis-attribution is the exact risk that froze cxapi go-live, and re-checking it per release is slow.
aha_moments.suggestion: Tenant comes from companyId and the wamid lookup is tenant-scoped via the composite UNIQUE, so an ack can only ever touch its own tenant's row.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The team opens the gate confident an ack can never write to the wrong tenant.

aha_moments.user_pain: A single shared webhook URL receiving both inbound chats and delivery acks looks like it would need a second integration/endpoint to configure.
aha_moments.suggestion: Shape discrimination on the one existing /webhook/event means WapCRM config is unchanged — no new URL, token, or endpoint to set up per tenant.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Go-live needs only flipping the allowlist, not re-touching every tenant's WapCRM webhook settings.

Q1.reasoning: Inbound path preserved: raw parse + discriminate, non-ack deserializes to IncomingWebhookEvent (cached Web opts), unchanged downstream + same 202.

Q2.reasoning: IsDeliveryAckShape false for non-object and for any root with a messages property; ambiguous {messages:[],Status:1} -> inbound 400; tested.
